CommunityApplications.Profile: junkerderprovinz Unraid templates. Community Applications templates for junkerderprovinz's self-hosted apps, in four groups. Own software: BombVault, featherdrop and TrickWork. Own image builds of third-party apps: JDownloader, Krusader, PrusaSlicer, Stellarium, Matrix, OpenCloud, HandBrake, StrawKnight, Excalidraw, Euro Office, Garage and JuiceFS. Thin wrappers over an upstream image: CouchDB, OpenHands, Standard Notes Server, Standard Notes Web UI, n8n, Claper, SeaweedFS, VersityGW and RustFS. Plugins: BombVault Widget, ShipLog and FireSquire. Each app folder has its own template, icon and README; images and full source live in their per-app repositories. Maintained by junkerderprovinz; support via the per-app Unraid forum threads.
